# BloomSense Amanai

> AI plant doctor and farming assistant by BloomSense. Diagnoses crop diseases from photos, gives IPM-based treatment plans, tracks plant growth with yield forecasts, remembers field history, and works fully offline for rural users.

Amanai (https://cpmishra.lovable.app) is a professional agricultural intelligence tool built for farmers, agronomists and agricultural extension workers, primarily in India.

## What Amanai does

- **Plant diagnosis**: answer a short triage (crop, symptoms, onset, environment) or upload a plant photo; Amanai identifies the problem and returns a structured 6-point report — Identity, Health, Diagnosis, Immediate Action, Prevention, Utility.
- **Treatment plans**: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) first, with chemical options and dosages, plus Indian government scheme references (PM-KISAN and similar).
- **Plant Journey** (https://cpmishra.lovable.app/journey): farmers photograph the same plant on a schedule; Amanai reads each check-in, tracks growth stage and vigour over time, and produces a yield forecast once enough data exists.
- **Field history log**: past diagnoses are stored per field and injected into future answers, so Amanai remembers what your field had before.
- **Offline mode**: an on-device disease library of 26 common crop problems (early blight, rice blast, wheat rust, mosaic virus, fall armyworm and more) answers questions with zero internet and syncs when back online.
- **Voice interface**: speak to Amanai hands-free.
- **MCP server**: external assistants (including a Chrome extension voice model) can call Amanai's tools — `ask_amanai`, `diagnose_crop`, `search_disease_library` — through an OAuth-protected MCP endpoint.

## Pages

- `/` — chat with Amanai, disease library, field log, memory viewer.
- `/journey` — Plant Journey: growth timeline, photo check-ins, yield prediction.
- `/install` — install the app as a PWA on phones and desktop.

## Audience

Farmers and agricultural professionals; supports English, Hindi and Odia.
